subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept deferred as a public cron/run status and expose yielded lifecycle helpers/callbacks through the plugin SDK in this PR?
rationale: The PR changes protocol, persisted status, CLI/UI filters, plugin hooks, and SDK exports, so source review and green tests cannot decide the product/API contract alone.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require rebase plus Discord, best-effort cron, and upgrade proof, then accept the public deferred status and SDK lifecycle contract.

options.title: Split Public Surface
options.body: Keep the internal yielded-parent fixes but split or defer the public deferred status and SDK expansion for separate API review.

options.title: Reject Broad Contract
options.body: Close or replace this PR with narrower existing wake/diagnostic fixes if maintainers do not want the new public lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require rebase plus Discord, best-effort cron, and upgrade proof, then accept the public deferred status and SDK lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers the adjacent agent/session and delivery boundary, and this decision spans runtime state plus public contract shape.
